limitations: Read-only service observation; no model loaded or inference triggered by collector
Inference latency is log-rounded to 1ms; 1/latency is not pipeline throughput
Model sample cadence is distinct from camera/video FPS
frameToResultSeconds starts at appsink enqueue arrival, not physical sensor exposure or browser display
Latest-only frame replacement means completed-inference FPS does not imply every camera frame was inferred
QNN/HTP log identity does not replace independent no-CPU-node profile evidence
This report never approves numerical parity, defect accuracy, calibration, or event ACK
MemoryPeak/VmHWM may include process activity before this observation window
Only allowlisted parsed fields are retained; journal messages and environment are not stored
